raw_tokens.value: Mythic Feat Output ~ Improved Bull Rush
You push foes around with amazing ease.

You gain a bonus equal to half your tier on checks to bull rush, and to your CMD when an opponent bull rushes you. These bonuses stack with those granted by non-mythic Improved Bull Rush.&nl;Furthermore, you can make an attack of opportunity against any creature that attempts to bull rush you, unless it also has this feat.
